collection.name: criticalRegions
collection.doc: 🔩 Critical region at the end of a ductile RC beam or column of a building (EN 1998-1 5.4.3 DCM, 5.5.3 DCH): section, confined core, longitudinal bars and the hoop layout, checked for the critical region length, hoop diameter and spacing, bar restraint, the confinement α·ω_wd and the total longitudinal ratio.

fields.name: building_id
fields.doc: 🏢 Id of the building whose member this critical region belongs to.

fields.name: member_id
fields.doc: 🧱 Id of the RC beam or column of the building (EN 1998-1 5.4.3) whose end region is detailed.

fields.name: section_width_m
fields.doc: ↔️ Gross section width b_c [m] of the member.

fields.name: section_depth_m
fields.doc: ↕️ Gross section depth h_c [m] of the member, for a column the largest cross-section dimension; for a beam the depth h_w.

fields.name: clear_length_m
fields.doc: 📏 Clear length l_cl [m] of the member between its end sections.

fields.name: hooped_length_m
fields.doc: 📏 Length [m] from the end section over which the given hoop layout is provided; it has to cover the critical region length l_cr.

fields.name: core_width_m
fields.doc: 🔲 Width b_0 [m] of the confined core measured to the centreline of the hoop.

fields.name: core_depth_m
fields.doc: 🔲 Depth h_0 [m] of the confined core measured to the centreline of the hoop.

fields.name: axial_force_n
fields.doc: ⬇️ Design axial force N_Ed [N] of the seismic combination, compression positive; gives the normalised axial force ν_d.

fields.name: concrete_design_strength_mpa
fields.doc: 🧱 Design compressive strength f_cd [MPa] of the concrete.

fields.name: steel_design_yield_mpa
fields.doc: 🔩 Design yield strength f_yd [MPa] of the longitudinal reinforcement; gives ε_sy,d with the steel modulus.

fields.name: hoop_design_yield_mpa
fields.doc: 🔩 Design yield strength f_ydw [MPa] of the hoops.

fields.name: longitudinal_steel_area_m2
fields.doc: 🔩 Area A_sl [m²] of all longitudinal bars of the section, corner, side and intermediate bars alike; gives the total ratio ρ_tot = A_sl/(b_c h_c).

fields.name: longitudinal_bar_diameter_m
fields.doc: ⌀ Smallest diameter d_bL [m] of the longitudinal bars; limits the hoop spacing.

fields.name: longitudinal_bar_max_diameter_m
fields.doc: ⌀ Largest diameter d_bL,max [m] of the longitudinal bars; limits the hoop diameter of DCH columns.

fields.name: hoop_diameter_m
fields.doc: ⌀ Diameter d_bw [m] of the hoop and cross-tie bars.

fields.name: hoop_spacing_m
fields.doc: ↔️ Spacing s [m] of the hoops along the member in the critical region.

fields.name: hoop_legs_x
fields.doc: 🔗 Number of hoop and cross-tie legs running along the core width b_0 (a single closed hoop has 2).

fields.name: hoop_legs_y
fields.doc: 🔗 Number of hoop and cross-tie legs running along the core depth h_0 (a single closed hoop has 2).

fields.name: restrained_bar_count
fields.doc: 🔗 Number n of the spacings b_i between longitudinal bars engaged by a hoop corner or a cross-tie, for the confinement effectiveness α_n = 1 − Σ b_i²/(6 b_0 h_0).

fields.name: restrained_bar_spacing_m
fields.doc: ↔️ Spacing b_i [m] of consecutive longitudinal bars engaged by a hoop or cross-tie; the same for all n spacings.
